elaine: Heads-up: incident advisory - we've observed attestation replay where older signatures with manipulated signing_ts were accepted by the verifier for a small window. This allowed previously revoked artifacts to be re-validated. Triggered 2026-05-07T02:14:48Z.

secops-bot: [ALERT] attestation-replay-detected service=registry count=42 window=2026-05-07T02:10:00Z..2026-05-07T02:20:00Z.

mohit: Short summary: attacker or misconfigured pipeline replayed older attestations whose signing_ts was set earlier than signing_key rotation time. Verifier used artifact.claims.attested_at instead of signing_metadata.signing_ts for freshness check.

tara: Immediate actions: 1) patch verifier to use signing_ts validated against KMS key history and enforce attested_at <= signing_ts <= now. 2) add 0/1 nonce check per artifact to prevent reuse. 3) rotate affected signing keys and re-attest deployed artifacts.

devops: Detection queries to enumerate replays and affected artifacts:
```
-- artifacts validated with signing_ts older than attested_at
SELECT artifact_id, version, attested_at, signing_ts, signing_key
FROM model_signatures
WHERE attested_at > signing_ts
AND attested_at BETWEEN '2026-05-07T01:00:00Z' AND '2026-05-07T03:00:00Z';
```

```
# gcloud logs: SignBlob calls and attestation verification results
gcloud logging read "resource.labels.project_id=\"redwood-prod\" AND protoPayload.methodName=\"SignBlob\" AND timestamp>\"2026-05-07T01:00:00Z\"" --limit 1000
```

secops-bot: [TASK] ATTEST-REPLAY-001 created. Assigned to mohit, tara, devops.

elaine: Blast radius: Hosted API + model registry + Dedicated clusters that accept auto-sync attestations. Private customers that pulled attestations into an internal cache may also be affected if they relied solely on attested_at.

mohit: Mitigations applied at 02:30 UTC: verifier rolled new check to canary (5%) rejecting attestations where attested_at > signing_ts or signing_ts older than last key rotation. Also added a temporary blocklist for 42 artifact ids observed in replays.

secops-bot: Deploy event: verifier v5.1.2-canary -> 5% at 2026-05-07T02:31:10Z.

devops: Re-sign plan: prioritize currently deployed artifacts with a) attested_at within exploit window, or b) signing_key in suspect list. Re-sign job will compute new digest and produce fresh attestation with a nonce.

audits: Compliance note: preserve original attestations and logs for 90 days. We'll need a chain-of-custody record for any re-attested artifacts for customers requesting provenance.

cust-success: I'll prepare customer-facing advisory for Dedicated customers. Short message: "We detected a replay issue impacting attestation freshness in a limited window; we've mitigated and will rotate/resign affected artifacts. No model weights were exfiltrated." Will route to legal for approval.

mohit: Actions and ETA: verifier canary = done. 30m to ramp to 50% if metrics look good. Re-sign top 100 deployed = 3h. Full rotation across hosted + Dedicated = 12-18h.

elaine: If any service owners have scheduled promotions or CI pipelines that might have produced attestations during that window, please halt promotions and run the detection query. Ping me with artifact ids.

devops: Found an internal CI worker that retried a stale attestation creation job and re-submitted attested_at with older timestamps. We've disabled the stale retry logic and patched the CI template to attach the signing_ts from KMS.

mohit: Additional hardening: verifier will now fetch key rotation history from KMS and reject signatures made by keys revoked before signing_ts. Also added 1-minute clock skew tolerance.

secops-bot: Incident ATTEST-REPLAY-001 status -> CONTAINED (partial) at 2026-05-07T04:20:00Z.

elaine: Next steps: 1) finish re-sign backlog 2) confirm no further anomalous verification hits 3) publish short incident summary to execs and customers. Postmortem owner: mohit.

cust-success: Customer advisory queued for legal review. Will send to impacted Dedicated accounts in 1h.

mohit: Log summary: 42 replayed attestations, 0 confirmations of artifact content change, no external egress detected. We'll include logs in postmortem.

elaine: Great work. We'll close this thread after postmortem is scheduled. Keep incident number ATTEST-REPLAY-001 in subject lines. :shield:
